declared_class: For each nontrivial bipartition of the eight 32-bit boundary words, the full state-residual vector is globally expressible either as L(X_A)+R(X_B) mod 2^32 componentwise or as L(X_A) xor R(X_B). A violating four-corner identity exactly refutes that partition and operation.
limitation: This does not cover bit-level separators, carry-state separators, coordinate transforms, approximate decompositions, or restricted subfamilies.
